prompt.title: Decorate together
prompt.free: No one is decorating right now
prompt.start.help: Once you start, you're in charge of the room. Your partner can only watch the conversation and preview.
prompt.idleHint: If nothing happens for 3 minutes, it's released automatically.
prompt.placeholder: How would you like to decorate?
prompt.input.partner: {name} is decorating, so you can't type right now
prompt.quota.title: You've used all of today's tries
prompt.quota.body: You can decorate up to 3 times a day. Requests that fail or are declined don't count. Pick it up again tomorrow — the room stays as it is.
prompt.consent.need: Both partners must agree to overseas AI processing before decorating
prompt.offline: You need an internet connection to decorate

prompt.brand.refuse: Specific characters and brands can't go in the room. Want me to make an item with a similar mood instead?
prompt.fail.title: Couldn't create a preview
prompt.fail.body: Try again in a moment. The room hasn't changed.

prompt.idle.me.title: Decorating was released automatically

prompt.takeover.body: There's been no activity for over 3 minutes, so you can take over. The conversation and preview so far stay visible.
prompt.msg.me: Make it a bit cozier. I'd like a cushion and a lamp.
prompt.msg.result: I added 1 cushion and 1 lamp. Take a look at the preview.
prompt.msg.status.cancelled: {name} canceled it. The room stays the same.
prompt.history.empty: No conversation yet. Describe the mood you want.

preview.cancel.toast: Canceled. Your room stays the same.
preview.applyHint: Applying changes the room for both of you, and it can't be undone once applied.
preview.undo: Go back to the previous preview
preview.confirm.title: Apply it?
preview.confirm.body: Your shared room will change for both of you. It can't be undone once applied, so take one more look at the preview first.
preview.partner.wait: {name} is deciding whether to apply it
preview.partner.readonly: You can only watch for now
preview.applied.title: Applied
preview.applied.body: Applied changes can't be undone. Your partner's screen updates as soon as it syncs.
preview.warn.limit: There are too many items, so a few are left out.
preview.warn.protected: Items that covered the buttons or the day counter were moved automatically.
preview.expiring: The session ends in {s}s. If you don't apply, only the preview remains.
preview.apply.err.title: Couldn't apply it

preview.model.err: Something went wrong while creating the preview. The room hasn't changed.
preview.conflict.title: The room just changed

preview.changes.list: Added a cushion, a lamp and a star
undo.title: Go back to the previous preview?
undo.body: This drops the change you just made in this conversation and goes back to the preview before it. The room hasn't changed. A room you already applied can't be undone.
undo.done.title: Undone
undo.done.body: This is the preview before it.
undo.none.title: Nothing to undo
undo.none.body: There are no changes from this conversation yet. A room you already applied can't be undone.
undo.busy.title: {name} is decorating
undo.conflict.title: It was already undone, or the preview changed
undo.conflict.body: We loaded the latest preview. Undo again if you still need to.
undo.err.title: Couldn't undo
undo.err.body: The preview is unchanged. Please try again.
consent.title: Room decorating is processed by AI overseas
consent.lead: When you ask to decorate, the information below is sent to an AI provider's servers overseas. Without consent, the day count and viewing the room still work.
consent.sent.label: What's sent
consent.sent.body: The request you typed, and the room layout needed to build it (item types, positions, text). Your together-date, names and email are not sent.
consent.purpose.label: Purpose
consent.purpose.body: To create a room preview that matches your request
consent.processor.label: Processed by
consent.processor.body: Anthropic PBC (United States). Sent through Aroom's servers.
consent.keep.label: Retention and withdrawal
consent.keep.body: Applied requests are deleted from Aroom's servers after 30 days, and unapplied previews after 24 hours. You can withdraw any time in Settings under "AI processing consent".
consent.provider.keep: Provider retention period: [fill in after legal review]
consent.couple.label: This room is shared by two
consent.couple.body: Consent is given per person. Yours applies only to requests you send. Requests include the room layout you two decorated together.
consent.withdraw.title: Withdraw your consent?
consent.withdraw.body: After you withdraw, requests are no longer sent overseas. The room stays as it is, and you'll need to agree again to decorate.
consent.later.note: You can't decorate until you agree. Viewing the room and the day count are unaffected.

end.b3: Deleted content can't be brought back

report.what: What do you want to report?
report.done.title: Report sent
report.done.body: We'll review it. We won't send you a separate result in the app.
report.fail.title: Couldn't send the report
report.fail.body: What you wrote is still here. Please try again.
report.block.title: Disconnect from {name}?
report.block.body: If you disconnect, {name} can no longer see this space's room or conversation, and the space ends. The data you shared will be deleted.
gen.refuse.title: We can't make that decoration
gen.refuse.ip: We can't make art that copies existing characters, brands, logos or someone else's work, because it could cause copyright problems. Try describing shapes and colors instead, like "a wall piece with soft yellow stars."
gen.refuse.people: We can't make pictures of real people or celebrities. Try a scene or pattern instead, like "a window view with the moon between clouds."
gen.refuse.unsafe: We can't make anything sexual, violent, hateful or harmful. Try describing something cozy instead.
gen.refuse.personal: We can't make pictures with phone numbers, addresses, links, QR codes or lots of text. You can add short text to the room separately.
gen.refuse.photo: We can't make realistic, photo-like images. Describe something soft and hand-drawn, like Aroomi's world.
gen.refuse.purpose: We can only make backgrounds, speech-bubble frames and small room props. We can't make characters, and Aroomi can't be changed. Try something like "a wavy band along the wall" or "a round cushion."
gen.refuse.note: This request didn't count toward today's limit.
gen.fail.title: We couldn't make it this time
gen.fail.body: Please try again in a moment. The room is unchanged, and this didn't use up today's limit.
gen.disabled.title: New decorations are taking a break
gen.disabled.body: You can still use the decorations you made and the other ways to decorate. Please check back later.
gen.lib.title: Our decorations
gen.lib.empty: No decorations yet. Try asking, like "make me a wall decoration."
gen.lib.delete.title: Delete this decoration?
gen.lib.delete.body: It will be gone from your collection and can't be brought back.
gen.lib.delete.inuse: It's in the room right now. Deleting it removes it from the room too.
gen.lib.full: Your collection is full. Please delete decorations you don't use.
